=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text tq "\""
text tex "\" exact "
text tin " inexact "
text tyes "yes"
text tno "no"
text p1 "rotor"
text p2 "level"
text p3 "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!"
text p4 "In girum imus nocte et consumimur igni"
text p5 "hello"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
fn emitb b bool to void
if b
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
end
note exact compares bytes from both ends
fn exact a view uchar * to bool
n = len a
for i ulong div n 2
if ne get a i get a sub sub n 1 i
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
note inexact keeps letters only, lower-cased, then compares (strings up to 256 bytes)
fn inexact a view uchar * to bool
b = new uchar 256 0
n = ulong 0
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 65 le c 90
c = add c 32
end
if and ge c 97 le c 122
put b n c
n = add n 1
end
end
ret exact part b 0 n
end
fn show a view uchar * to void
emit tq
emit a
emit tex
emitb exact a
emit tin
emitb inexact a
emit nl
end
fn main to int
show p1
show p2
show p3
show p4
show p5
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
"rotor" exact yes inexact yes
"level" exact yes inexact yes
"A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!" exact no inexact yes
"In girum imus nocte et consumimur igni" exact no inexact yes
"hello" exact no inexact no
</pre>
